selection: Follow-up after ViLD metadata coverage results; no ViLD image/model scores inspected. Existing CAMP transfer encoder reused without tuning.
model: CAMP University-1652 checkpoint; cross-dataset transfer, not CAEVL reproduction
evaluation_split: test with minimum distance to any val query >=500m
gallery: union of val and test reference images within each flight; sorted filename tie order
deletion: permuted whole 500m cells until target entry count reached; paired uniform random sample removes exactly same count
calibration_rule: largest tie-complete confidence prefix with empirical error<=0.1 and >=8 occupied 500m cells. Descriptive fit; no finite-sample risk guarantee.

primary.rule: all 20 masks feasible; at least 1 mean fewer error AND 10% relative error reduction. Internal continuity rule, not universal academic standard. Original failures retained.

ranking: full FP32 dot product computed once per query; stable descending sort. Delete by masking this ordering; same-gallery exact ties preserve filename order.
reporting: created errors with coverage absent versus present
correct replacement rejected by historical-winner guard
limits: repeated masks and frames are not independent sites
follow-up does not overwrite previous SUES/DenseUAV failures
val/test shared-gallery protocol is not original benchmark replication
